title: Virginia Avenue over I-65 NB / I-70 EB | proposed 2026 rehabilitation
source_note: INDOT B-44576 primary 2026 design. Retained original framing and 2013 northbound girder replacement are sourced only from identified pages of document 9548460. Separate southbound/I-70, cathodic-protection and lighting pages are not dimensional authority. Original files remain unchanged.
status_note: Whole crossing present; amber because field elevations, wing footing levels, connections, rail/approach transitions and small fittings remain approximate. Proposed 2026 work is not proof of completion.
assumptions: Whole-crossing exterior reconstruction of the stated proposed design, not an as-built survey or confirmation of construction completion.
Amber / needs_detail: fabrication tolerances, exact field seats, local notches and transitions, small fittings, and terrain remain incomplete.
Internal reinforcement, shear studs, embedded anchors and welds are omitted. No rendered component is a finite element or a solid-stress result.
Any later FEM must freeze its own material, stiffness, connectivity and support assumptions. Visual mesh volume is not a section-property source.
Foundations are hidden by default; foundation envelopes are design references and do not establish actual field embedment.
Linear grade through the primary bearing profile elevations replaces the 90/96 ft vertical curves; deck height is a local visualization datum.
Historical 54/60 in labels are WEB depths; total I-section depths include both flanges. Plate schedules are source-backed, but fillets and taper details are simplified.
Source revisions 9715471 and 9715512 concern special provisions and inspection coordination; no replacement geometry sheets were identified.

detail_coverage.detail: Nine girders, 2026 deck, broad south path, narrow north sidewalk, all bays, both wall abutments and approach slabs. Retained 1971 wings A to D splayed and battered as drawn, with their abutment returns and footings (existing S-2 to S-6).

Piecewise 2013 girder 1 and original girders 2-9; splice covers, V/X frames and 18 bearing envelopes. Historical original PDF references are stored per component. 2013 Girder 1-2 end cross-frames on both bearing lines (existing sheets 10, 14). 1971 jacking frames J.F.1 / J.F.2 on both bearing lines of bays 2-8 (existing S-7, S-8; height on the web scaled; centre stiffeners included). 2013 bay 1 intermediate V frames at the sheet 10 stations with their 7 x 5/8 in connection plates (existing sheets 10, 14; gusset at the foot of the V omitted).
TX windowed rail, south ornamental top rail, paver envelope, six light bollards and source drain collector.
Exact field seats and camber, bolts/gussets, local abutment batter, transition rail terminals, paver pattern, exact rail molds, buried utilities and surrounding interstate.

known_deviations.source: existing plans 9548460 S-8 (PDF 66): Jacking Frame J.F.1 & 2; Conn. PL Detail - J.F.1, 2 & E.D.1
known_deviations.deviation: The jacking-frame ends are an envelope. The I-section runs to vertical planes parallel to the girder webs, 3 in (0.0762 m) from the web centre lines. The bent 1/2 x 7 in connection plates, their bolts (two rows 3 in apart, 12 spa. @ 3 in) and the 7/8 x 9 5/8 in bearing stiffeners they are welded to are not modelled. On S-8 the 3 in (Typ.) locates the plate leg along the girder web; the frame web is bolted to the skewed leg of the plate, and where the frame itself ends is not shown.
known_deviations.reason: S-8 gives no dimension for the frame end along the bearing line, the plate leg lengths, bend or plate height, and the detail does not scale consistently (its 3 in, 4 1/2 in and bolt spacings scale differently). The bearing stiffeners are located on the bearing centre line, but they cannot be added alone: they would pass through the modelled frame ends (61.7 cm3 per frame end) and the 2013 end-frame W16 at Girder 2 (56.3 cm3 per bearing line), whose real copes are not dimensioned. Shop drawings or a field measurement of the end connection would settle it. The S-8 centre stiffeners are modelled.

known_deviations.source: existing plans 9548460 sheet 14 (PDF 32): Intermediate Cross-Frame Details, northbound structure; sheet 10 (PDF 28): Framing Plan - N.B.
known_deviations.deviation: The 3/8 in gusset plate at the foot of the V is not modelled. The two L5x5x3/8 diagonals are carried down to the top of the bottom strut, where their centre lines meet at the bay centre, and meet each other on the bay centre plane (one V-shaped body standing on the strut); on sheet 14 they stop short of the strut and of each other and are bolted to the gusset, with the work point drawn within about 1 in of the strut top. The angles are their connected 5 in legs as 3/8 in strips; outstanding legs, the 7/8 in bolts (slotted holes at Girder 1) and the welds are omitted. The members end 0.02 m from the web centre lines (the generator's offset); sheet 14 draws the angle ends about 1 in off the webs.
known_deviations.reason: Sheet 14 draws the gusset and the angle ends but dimensions neither (the gusset scales about 14 1/2 x 12 in, which is not used). Which face of the connection plate the angles bear on is not dimensioned either; the sheet 10 framing plan draws the frame lines on the up-station side of the plate ticks, which is used. Shop drawings of the 2013 Girder 1 replacement or a field measurement would settle them.

findings.end-struts-bays-2-8: Resolved as jacking frames. E.S.1 / E.S.2 and F.S.1 / F.S.2 on S-7 are the expansion and fixed shoes of S-9 (already the bearing envelopes). Added J.F.1 (bays 2-7) and J.F.2 (bay 8) on both bearing lines: PL 1/2 x 42 in web, PL 5/8 x 9 in flanges, on the centre line of the top shoes (S-7, S-8), retained in 2026 (sheet 38). 14 parts, each with its two S-8 centre stiffeners PL 7/8 x 4 1/4 in (28 plates, part of the frame meshes).
findings.drain-station-abutment-2: SQ-A inlet centre X +12.190012 -> +11.945112 m (Sta. 13+88.30 -> 13+87.50, sheet 36); the downpipe follows (-0.244900 m in X).
findings.drain collector routing (independent che: Straight visual collector through B2_bearing_6-9 (30-11091 cm3 each) at a 0.484 % fall -> sheet 39 routing: downpipe to an elbow under the top of the wall, 6 in collector along the Abutment 2 wall face on the downpipe centre line, 0.5 % fall to the north end, drop down the wall face. Overlaps with bearings 0; only the inlet embedment in the deck remains.

decisions.jacking frame height on the girder web: Not dimensioned on any sheet. Modelled with the top 5 1/4 in below the girder top (bottom 14 in above the girder bottom), scaled from the S-8 Jacking Frame J.F.1 & 2 elevation, which is the member's own detail and is drawn with the frame-to-girder depth ratio to within 1 % (scaled 4.9-5.5 in / 13.3-14.0 in). Not used: the sheet 38 background sketch (about 7.8 in), which draws the girder 60 in deep instead of 62.5 in. Expected uncertainty about +/-2.5 in.
decisions.jacking frame ends: Kept as an envelope (see known_deviations jacking-frame-end-connections): the section stops on planes parallel to the girder webs 3 in from the web centre lines. On S-8 the 3 in (Typ.) locates the leg of the bent 1/2 in connection plate along the web, not the frame end; where the frame ends is not dimensioned.
decisions.jacking frame centre stiffeners: S-8 "7/8 x 4 1/4 in Stiff. PL (Ea. Side)" at the jacking-frame centre line, read 4 1/4 in (not 4 1/2): (9 - 1/2) / 2 = 4 1/4 reaches the flange edges. Placed at mid-frame between the girder centre lines, the drawn centre line, full height between the flanges; built into each frame mesh.
decisions.connection parts not added: The bent 1/2 x 7 in plates and bolts have no leg lengths, bend or height on S-8. The 7/8 x 9 5/8 in bearing stiffeners are located (bearing centre line, both sides of the web) but would intersect the frame-end envelope (61.7 cm3 per frame end) and the 2013 end-frame W16 at Girder 2 (56.3 cm3 per bearing line); fitting them needs the frame and end-frame copes, which no sheet dimensions. Kept in known_deviations jacking-frame-end-connections.
decisions.drain collector offset from the wall fac: Not dimensioned (sheet 39 not to scale). Section K-K draws the downpipe, reducer and collector on one centre line against the wall face, so the collector runs parallel to the skewed wall face on the downpipe centre line: 0.2198 m normal to the face of the abutment_2 envelope, set by the inlet position.
decisions.drain collector elevation: Not dimensioned. Sheet 39 draws the elbow and run just under the top of the wall and below the girders; the pipe top is put at the top of the wall (z 5.9787 m) at the south elbow, falling exactly 0.5 % (the minimum) to the north end.
decisions.drain north drop: Sheet 39 drops the pipe down the wall face to existing grade, which the model does not have; the drop ends at the foot of the abutment_2 envelope (z 0.65 m, top of the footing envelope).

review_correction_record_3d.source: Second 3D review of revision 1.3 (finding VA-07), re-measured on the GLB and re-read against the drawings

findings.VA-07: Resolved. The five bay 1 intermediate frames are rebuilt as existing sheets 10 and 14 draw them. Before: the 0.10 m lower strut crossed the Girder 1 bottom flange in every frame (overlap 548.0-589.6 cm3; at the review probe 13.2 mm below the flange soffit), the twisted diagonals cut 7.9 cm3 into the Girder 2 web and frame 1 lay in the Girder 1 Splice "A" cover plates (38.3 cm3). After: frames at the sheet 10 stations (15 ft 3 in + 4 spa. @ 22 ft along Girder 1; 1.0045 m down-station), bottom strut 3 in above the Girder 1 bottom flange, diagonal tops 6 in below the Girder 2 top flange (sheet 14 minima), ten 7 x 5/8 in connection plates on the webs, flange to flange (sheets 10, 14); every member laps both plates; largest overlap with any part 0.0013 cm3 (float32 rounding of the touching faces).

decisions.Frame stations: Sheet 10 dimensions the bay 1 frames along New Girder No. 1 from C/L bearing (15 ft 3 in, 4 spa. @ 22 ft 0 in, 10 ft 9 in); the generator measured the 15 ft 3 in at mid-bay. The frames move 1.0045 m down-station; at the old station frame 1 and its Girder 1 connection plate would lie in the Splice "A" cover plates.
decisions.Strut and diagonal levels: Sheet 14 gives minima: bottom strut 3 in above the top of the bottom flange, diagonals 6 in below the underside of the top flange, and draws the detail at both. Applied to the governing girder of the model (Girder 1 bottom flange is the higher, Girder 2 top flange the lower; the 2013 sheet draws the girders the other way round, "Varies").
decisions.Connection plate side: Not dimensioned. Centred on the frame station with the angles on its up-station face, as the sheet 10 framing plan draws the frame line beside the plate ticks.
decisions.Member ends: Kept at the generator's 0.02 m from the web centre lines (12.06 mm clear of the webs); sheet 14 does not dimension them.
decisions.Gusset: Drawn, not dimensioned: not modelled; the diagonals stand on the strut at the bay centre (known_deviations bay1-intermediate-frame-gussets).

kept.bay1-intermediate-frame-gussets: Sheet 14 draws the gusset and the angle ends but dimensions neither (the gusset scales about 14 1/2 x 12 in, which is not used). Which face of the connection plate the angles bear on is not dimensioned either; the sheet 10 framing plan draws the frame lines on the up-station side of the plate ticks, which is used. Shop drawings of the 2013 Girder 1 replacement or a field measurement would settle them.

review_correction_record_3d_2.source: Second 3D review of revision 1.4 (wing envelopes), re-measured on the GLB and re-read against the drawings
review_correction_record_3d_2.native_axes: X increasing station (X = 0 at 13+48.31 "Vir"), Y positive to the left looking up-station (south), Z up; GLB (X, Z, -Y)

findings.Wing envelopes: Resolved. The four wings were 20 ft x 0.36 m slabs along the coping lines with a flat top at Z 5.753 / 5.729, 2.42-2.96 m below the deck, path and approach-slab top beside them, so the approach fill stood above them; 0.70-0.86 m3 of each lay inside the abutment envelope. They are rebuilt as the 1971 plans draw Wings A to D: splayed 24 deg 30 min (A, D, 48 ft 6 1/2 in) and 65 deg 30 min (B, C, 19 ft 6 3/4 in) from the abutment line, 1 ft 2 in top, back face battered to 2 ft 6 in, top falling from the joint-end elevation (Z 8.494-8.702, 0.09-0.16 m above the path or sidewalk beside the root) to the tip (Z 5.507-6.589), each with its 1 ft 0 in abutment return against the abutment envelope and a 16 ft x 2 ft footing (new parts). Largest overlap with any part 0.0000 cm3 (float32 rounding of touching faces).

datum_checks.plan: The reconstructed outer faces lie within about 0.2 m of the existing wings drawn on the 2026 sheet 32 removal plan (vector linework), which also confirms which wing is which.

decisions.Wing identities: By the drawn geometry, not the ids: S-2 puts Wings A / C at plan top, the left side looking up-station (+Y, south), B / D at plan bottom (-Y); A and B at Abutment 1. So wing_1_-1 = A, wing_1_1 = B, wing_2_-1 = C, wing_2_1 = D (the long wings A and D are at the obtuse corners). The 2026 sheet 32 plan draws them where they are rebuilt.
decisions.Plan: S-3 / S-5 give the splay from the abutment line (24 deg 30 min, 65 deg 30 min; they sum to 90 deg) and the middle wall joint 2 ft 6 3/4 in from the W.P.; Section E-E gives the stem front face to its corners (46 ft 9 1/4 in, 41 ft 4 3/4 in) and the returns to the wing joints (4 ft 11 1/4 in, 8 ft 3 1/2 in); Section A-A puts the stem front face 1 ft 4 1/2 in ahead of the bearing line. Abutment 2 is the point image of Abutment 1 (S-5 / S-6 repeat every plan dimension).
decisions.Datum: Z = 0.3048 El - 214.6496 m: the model grade passes through the sheet 31 P.G. at both bearing lines. It matches the drawn Abutment 2 footing to 2 cm; the model seat datum (bearing stacks) is 9 / 14 cm below the drawn seats and the footing_1 envelope 0.26 / 0.30 m below the drawn Abutment 1 footing (both envelopes are unchanged).
decisions.Top thickness: Section B-B dimensions the top 1 ft 2 in overall (2 in + 1 ft 0 in); 1 ft 2 in is used.
decisions.Tip elevations: The drawn tip elevations are used (Wing A El. 725.85, Wing B El. 722.65); the height dimensions above the wing footing (16 ft 7 1/8 in, 13 ft 4 5/8 in) give 0.03 ft less.
decisions.Abutment returns: Section E-E draws 1 ft 0 in returns from the stem corners along the wing lines to the C/L of the 1 in joints. The abutment_1 / abutment_2 envelopes end at the coping lines, so each return is modelled in the wing part from that end face to the joint; its top is the wing's joint-end elevation (the S-3 / S-5 elevations draw the wall end rising to it; not dimensioned) and its bottom the abutment footing top.
decisions.Wing footings: S-3 / S-5 wing footing plans: 16 ft 0 in x the wing length; Section B-B: 2 ft 0 in, toe 2 ft 6 in, heel 11 ft 0 in. Modelled from the C/L of the joint to the tip as new parts in the foundations layer (hidden by default, like footing_1 / footing_2); levels: known_deviations wing-footing-levels.
decisions.2026 contract: No wing work: sheet 32 draws the wings outside the removal limits, sheet 38 draws them in the background of the abutment elevations, and the approach sheets 41 to 47 end at the coping lines.
